sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在努力以一种现实的方式优先考虑我的健康，而让我保持动力的一个因素就是我的WHOOP。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常看重数据的人，这就是我喜欢WHOOP的原因，因为我可以真正看出为什么我的身体在不同日子里会有不同的感觉，为什么我的跑步状态不同，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我可能没那么专注。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP可以轻松追踪我的睡眠、身体压力、恢复情况、压力水平，最重要的是，我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供了所有这些数据和模式，让我能够做出更好的决定，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该努力。

sentences.en: New members can try WHOOP with a 30-day free trial before committing to a membership.

sentences.zh: 一张照片、一件衣服、一件来自难忘之地的微小纪念品。

sentences.en: In my new podcast, Charmed, with Sam Todd, we explore the memories, obsessions, and personal treasures that become part of who we are.
sentences.zh: 在我和Sam Todd合作的新播客《Charmed》中，我们探索了那些成为我们生命一部分的记忆、执念和个人珍宝。

sentences.en: From the sublime all the way to the absolutely ridiculous, it's a fascinating deep dive into the keepsakes we hold close and the memories that make them special.
sentences.zh: 从崇高到绝对荒谬，这是一次对我们珍视的纪念品以及赋予它们特殊意义的记忆的迷人深度挖掘。

sentences.en: Charmed with me, Sam Todd.
sentences.zh: 《Charmed》，我是Sam Todd。

sentences.zh: 与Pandora一起讲述那些愿意分享的故事。

sentences.zh: 请于10月13日开始，在iHeartRadio应用程序、Apple Podcasts或任何你获取播客的地方收听《The Builders》。

sentences.zh: 这个矮小的女士走进来，我们几乎看不到她高出柜台。

sentences.zh: 关于我们的一切都在尖叫着：

sentences.zh: 我不是国际银行家。

sentences.zh: 刚才那段音频来自我们最新的热门播客，

sentences.zh: 《Royal Swindle》，讲述了两个非常不可思议的骗子的故事。

sentences.en: These Australian women charmed their way into British high society, won over England's horse-loving elite, and even met the Queen, all while conning people out of their fortunes.
sentences.zh: 这些澳大利亚女性通过魅力混入了英国上流社会，赢得了英国热爱马术的精英阶层的青睐，甚至见到了女王，而这一切都是在骗取他人财富的同时完成的。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《The Psychology of Your 20s》，在这个播客中，我们探讨20多岁时的一些重大生活变化和转型，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hi, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: I'm not going to do my cheery little intro today.
sentences.zh: 今天我不想做我那套欢快的开场白了。

sentences.en: I assume that you already know what we're talking about, given that you clicked on this episode, and you probably also have guessed or assumed
sentences.zh: 我想既然你点击了这一集，你肯定已经知道我们在谈论什么，而且你可能也猜到或预料到，

sentences.en: that this episode is going to be a little bit different, a little bit more vulnerable, open, dare I say, chatty, maybe not chatty, just honeSt.
sentences.zh: 这一集会有点不同，会更脆弱、更开放，甚至可以说，更随性，也许不是随性，只是诚实。

sentences.en: And, you know, I felt really strange making this episode compared to my usual content.
sentences.zh: 你知道，与我平时的内容相比，制作这一集让我感觉非常奇怪。

sentences.en: You know, you come here to learn about the psychology of your 20s and the psychology of flirting and breakups and career anxiety and transitions.
sentences.zh: 你知道，大家来这里是为了了解20多岁的心理学，了解调情、分手、职业焦虑和人生转型的心理学。

sentences.en: We're not going to be really doing that today.
sentences.zh: 但我们今天不会真的谈论这些。

sentences.en: We're not going to be having that usual structure and scientific approach.
sentences.zh: 我们不会采用那种惯常的结构和科学方法。

sentences.en: I want to just take a moment to really get you guys up to speed on what I've been going through.
sentences.zh: 我只想花点时间，真正让你们了解我最近经历的一切。

sentences.en: You know, for a long time, I've been doing this podcast for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很长一段时间以来，我一直在做这个播客。

sentences.en: And along that journey, I've been, I would hope, transparent around what is going on in my own personal life.
sentences.zh: 在这一过程中，我希望我一直对自己的个人生活保持透明。

sentences.en: Sometimes I've tried to, you know, create more of a distance or a space between my personal life and what I talk about on the show,
sentences.zh: 有时我试图在个人生活和我节目中谈论的内容之间制造更多的距离或空间，

sentences.en: but it's very hard for it not to kind of infiltrate and come to the surface because the topics and the ideas and the opinions that I express
sentences.zh: 但这些内容很难不渗透进来并浮出水面，因为我表达的话题、观点和想法，

sentences.en: are all derived from personal experience.
sentences.zh: 都源于个人的经历。

sentences.en: And because of that, it felt strange just moving on with regularly scheduled programming and not talking about something pretty serious and hard that I've been through recently,
sentences.zh: 正因如此，如果我继续按计划播出常规节目，而不谈论我最近经历的那些相当严重和艰难的事情，会让我觉得很奇怪，

sentences.en: which is that I basically had a mental breakdown.
sentences.zh: 那就是我基本上经历了一次精神崩溃。

sentences.en: There it is.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: I said it out loud.
sentences.zh: 我把它说出来了。

sentences.en: I had a really, really rough time this past month that has completely, really shaken me to my core and has kind of made me reconsider my place in the world,
sentences.zh: 过去的一个月我过得非常非常艰难，这彻底动摇了我的内心，让我重新审视了我在这个世界上的位置，

sentences.en: made me reconsider mental health in a complete new light, spiritual health in a new light, you know, this decade in a new light.
sentences.zh: 让我以一种全新的视角重新审视了心理健康、精神健康，以及这个十年。

sentences.en: And I really want to kind of share what that was like, what that experience was like going through it for those of you who might be going through something similar.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想分享那是什么感觉，对于那些可能正在经历类似事情的人来说，那种经历是怎样的。

sentences.en: And like I said, I really debated talking about this.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我真的纠结过要不要谈论这个。

sentences.en: It is so just inherently vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 这本质上就是如此脆弱。

sentences.en: But, you know, I've spoken about breakups.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我谈论过分手。

sentences.en: I've spoken about grief.
sentences.zh: 我谈论过悲伤。

sentences.en: I've spoken about, you know, losing family members.
sentences.zh: 我谈论过失去家庭成员。

sentences.en: I've spoken about my physical health.
sentences.zh: 我谈论过我的身体健康。

sentences.en: And why does, you know, the ball have to stop there?
sentences.zh: 为什么话题到这里就必须停止呢？

sentences.en: Why do we then tend to shy away when it comes to talking about our mental health with the same openness and authenticity and honesty that we would discuss all these other topics
sentences.zh: 为什么当谈到心理健康时，我们往往会退缩，而不能像讨论其他话题和这十年中的其他经历那样，保持同样的开放、真实和诚实呢？

sentences.en: and all these other experiences of this decade?
sentences.zh: 以及这十年中的所有其他经历？

sentences.en: This is my reality at the moment.
sentences.zh: 这就是我当下的现实。

sentences.en: It's something that I'm going through.
sentences.zh: 这是我正在经历的事情。

sentences.en: And as sad as it is, unfortunate as it is, I also know that there are many of you who are probably going through this as well.
sentences.zh: 虽然这很悲伤，很不幸，但我知道你们中也有很多人可能正在经历同样的事情。

sentences.en: And you feel so completely, entirely alone.
sentences.zh: 而且你感到如此彻底、完全的孤独。

sentences.en: And so whilst like this podcast is obviously about providing science and evidence in this self-help space and giving you like factual wellness content, it's also about community.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然这个播客显然是关于在自助领域提供科学和证据，并为你提供事实性的健康内容，但它也是关于社区的。

sentences.en: And it's also about being able to see your experiences reflected back in thousands, if not millions of others.
sentences.zh: 它也是关于能够看到你的经历在成千上万，甚至数百万其他人身上得到反映。

sentences.en: You know, whatever you're struggling with, I think there is a huge comfort that comes from knowing that you are not alone in that experience,
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论你正在为什么而挣扎，我认为知道你并不是唯一一个有这种经历的人，会带来巨大的安慰，

sentences.en: that there is someone somewhere elsewhere who is navigating the same challenges as you are.
sentences.zh: 知道在某个地方，有另一个人正在经历和你一样的挑战。

sentences.en: The big problem I find, or the big hurdle I find with talking about, you know, mental health very explicitly and, you know, not just saying, yeah, I have mental health struggles,
sentences.zh: 我发现谈论心理健康时最大的问题，或者说最大的障碍，不仅仅是说“是的，我有心理健康方面的挣扎”，

sentences.en: but being like, no, I've had a full, you know, mental breakdown, prolonged depressive episode, massive anxiety, is that you do still recognise the stigma that is attached.
sentences.zh: 而是说“不，我经历了一次彻底的精神崩溃、长期的抑郁发作、巨大的焦虑”，你仍然会意识到其中所附带的污名。

sentences.en: Even in this space, even though I've made, and you know, this is my career, I talk about psychology.
sentences.zh: 即使在这个领域，即使我已经做了这些，而且你知道，这是我的职业，我谈论心理学。

sentences.en: Talking about psychology and talking about the very real lived experience of mental health is quite different and is opening yourself up to a lot of misunderstanding.
sentences.zh: 谈论心理学和谈论心理健康非常真实的亲身经历是完全不同的，这会让你面临很多误解。

sentences.en: And that's something that I've kind of accepted in talking about this today is that, you know, people could listen to this and just be like, hi, like, what is she talking about?
sentences.zh: 这就是我今天谈论这个话题时所接受的一点，你知道，人们可能会听了之后说：“嗨，她在说什么？”

sentences.en: Or maybe people will listen to this and be like, well, you know, I'm not going to listen to such an untrustworthy narrator from now on,
sentences.zh: 或者人们可能会听了之后说：“好吧，从现在开始我不会再听这样一个不可信的叙述者了”，

sentences.en: you know, because she's not talking about mental health in like, you know, in like a guarded way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，因为她谈论心理健康的方式不是那种防御性的方式。

sentences.en: She's talking about it very openly and with great realness and that can be really confronting for some people.
sentences.zh: 她谈论得非常开放且非常真实，这对某些人来说可能真的会让人感到难以接受。

sentences.en: So I would just ask for grace.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是请求大家的宽容。

sentences.en: This episode is not structured.
sentences.zh: 这一集没有结构。

sentences.en: It's going to be a bit of a ramble.
sentences.zh: 这会是一次随性的漫谈。

sentences.en: And I've kind of accepted that some people might be shocked to hear this.
sentences.zh: 我已经接受了有些人听到这些可能会感到震惊。

sentences.en: Some people might be confronted.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会感到难以接受。

sentences.en: So just check in on yourself as to where you are.
sentences.zh: 所以请审视一下你自己的状态。

sentences.en: And if you think this will be helpful, please listen on.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为这会有所帮助，请继续收听。

sentences.en: If you just want like to know what it's like, I guess, or to see or to be able to provide help with for someone else who, you know, who might be going through the same experience.
sentences.zh: 如果你只是想知道那是什么感觉，或者为了能够帮助那些可能正在经历同样经历的人。

sentences.en: That is really my ultimate goal here is to provide a lived experience for you to reflect on in your own life when you confront scary topics such as and scary ideas such as the ones
sentences.zh: 这确实是我在这里的最终目标，即提供一种亲身经历，供你在面对可怕的话题和想法时，在自己的生活中进行反思，

sentences.en: that I've been working through.
sentences.zh: 就像我一直在努力解决的那些问题一样。

sentences.en: If you have been listening for a while, you'll know that every now and again, I give like a mental health update because this is like a mental health podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你已经听了一段时间，你就会知道，我时不时会更新一下心理健康状况，因为这是一个心理健康播客。

sentences.en: And a few months ago, I even gave like an update where I was like, I am doing so well.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我甚至还做过一次更新，当时我说：“我做得非常好。”

sentences.en: I'm thriving.
sentences.zh: 我正在蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: I'm living my best life.
sentences.zh: 我正在过着我最好的生活。

sentences.en: I'm like going off my antidepressants.
sentences.zh: 我正在停止服用抗抑郁药。

sentences.en: Like everything is good.
sentences.zh: 一切都很好。

sentences.en: We're making forward progress.
sentences.zh: 我们正在向前迈进。

sentences.en: And then things changed as they very often do with our brains and our minds and our perception and our health.
sentences.zh: 然后事情发生了变化，就像我们的大脑、思维、感知和健康状况经常发生的那样。

sentences.en: You think you're doing very, very well.
sentences.zh: 你以为你做得非常好。

sentences.en: But one of the realities of living with a mental health condition is that kind of in the back of your mind, you always know that there is, there is a time that will come
sentences.zh: 但患有心理健康疾病的现实之一是，在你的潜意识里，你总是知道会有那么一个时刻到来，

sentences.en: where it could get worse.
sentences.zh: 情况可能会变得更糟。

sentences.en: And so even if you are feeling amazing and fabulous and enjoying life, it's a, there's a hesitancy.
sentences.zh: 所以即使你感觉很棒、很美妙，正在享受生活，也会有一种犹豫。

sentences.en: There is a sense of like tiptoeing around that experience.
sentences.zh: 有一种小心翼翼地对待那种体验的感觉。

sentences.en: Like, oh, how long is this going to last?
sentences.zh: 就像，“哦，这种情况会持续多久？”

sentences.en: How long am I going to feel like this?
sentences.zh: “我会这样感觉多久？”

sentences.en: Because you know that the other shoe might eventually drop.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道另一只鞋可能会掉下来。

sentences.en: You know, you might get bad again and you hope not.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可能会再次变糟，你希望不会。

sentences.en: But that is the case.
sentences.zh: 但事实就是如此。

sentences.en: And that is what happened with me.
sentences.zh: 这就是发生在我身上的事情。

sentences.en: I went from being super, super happy and then there was just this slow descent.
sentences.zh: 我从超级超级快乐的状态，然后就开始了缓慢的下滑。

sentences.en: And always in hindsight, can you see the path that you've taken, right?
sentences.zh: 事后回顾时，你总能看到你所走过的道路，对吧？

sentences.en: In the moment, you just want to survive and push forward.
sentences.zh: 在当下，你只想生存并继续前进。

sentences.en: You're hoping that it's like hormonal or contextual or it's just because you're really stressed and then the stress fades and then, you know, the days go on.
sentences.zh: 你希望这只是荷尔蒙或环境因素，或者只是因为你压力太大，然后压力消退了，日子也就这样过下去了。

sentences.en: And it's like, oh, I just can't get these thoughts out of my head.
sentences.zh: 然后你会觉得，“哦，我就是无法把这些想法赶出脑海。”

sentences.en: My biggest fixation and the thing that really culminated in me really kind of just not being able to cope for a while there had to do with thoughts and anxieties is around death.
sentences.zh: 我最大的执念，以及最终导致我有一段时间无法应对的事情，与关于死亡的想法和焦虑有关。

sentences.en: I have very intense death anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我有非常强烈的死亡焦虑。

sentences.en: Feels weird to say that out loud.
sentences.zh: 大声说出来感觉很奇怪。

sentences.en: I'm sure some of you may have realized that or guessed it, but it's not something I talk about that much because to be honest, talking about it, it like puts it,
sentences.zh: 我相信你们中的一些人可能已经意识到了或猜到了，但这并不是我经常谈论的事情，因为老实说，谈论它会把它，

sentences.en: like you squarely have to face it and it's right there and it's like incredibly terrible,
sentences.zh: 就像你必须直面它，它就在那里，这是一种极其可怕的、

sentences.en: inevitable fear.
sentences.zh: 不可避免的恐惧。

sentences.en: It's, I think, the most profound fear to fear death because everything else in life, you know, you can kind of avoid or you can change your behaviors to avoid
sentences.zh: 我认为，恐惧死亡是最深刻的恐惧，因为生活中的其他一切，你知道，你都可以避开，或者你可以改变你的行为来避免，

sentences.en: and death is one of those things that you just can't and you have to try and find a way to create a meaning in a finite life and to,
sentences.zh: 而死亡是你无法避免的，你必须尝试找到一种方法在有限的生命中创造意义，并，

sentences.en: you know, have some form of comfort or vision
sentences.zh: 你知道，拥有一种安慰或愿景，

sentences.en: or value or life philosophy that lets you push forward and I just kind of lost that.
sentences.zh: 或价值观，或人生哲学，让你能够继续前进，而我只是失去了这些。

sentences.en: I just no longer could access my purpose and my meaning and my life philosophy around why are we here?
sentences.zh: 我再也无法触及我的目标、意义以及关于“我们为什么在这里”的人生哲学。

sentences.en: What are we doing here?
sentences.zh: 我们在这里做什么？
